title: Drivers Carried Free on a Car Rental Agreement by Traveller Club Standing
content:
How many additional drivers an agreement on the Car Rental Rate Classes carries free of charge is decided by the traveller club membership standing in the renter's name, held with the Wanderlane Traveller Club, together with the qualifying points that membership has accrued over the last twelve months.

**The entitlement schedule.**

| The membership standing in the renter's name | Drivers carried free |
|---|---|
| Active at Wanderlane Platinum, Wanderlane Titanium or Wanderlane Ambassador, with at least 20000 qualifying points accrued in the last twelve months | 3 |
| Active at Wanderlane Gold or Wanderlane Silver, with at least 6000 qualifying points accrued in the last twelve months | 2 |
| Any other standing | The free count the rate class itself states |

Each of the first two entitlements is a compound condition: the tier and the points must hold together. A membership at one of the three highest named tiers that has accrued fewer than 20000 qualifying points in the last twelve months does not carry 3 free drivers; a membership at Wanderlane Gold or Wanderlane Silver that has accrued fewer than 6000 qualifying points in that period does not carry 2. A membership that is not active carries neither. The qualifying points counted are those accrued on the membership's points record over the twelve months preceding the handling date; points of any other kind, and points older than twelve months, are not counted.

**Both sides of each threshold.** A membership at Wanderlane Titanium with exactly 20000 qualifying points in the last twelve months carries 3 free drivers, because the entitlement turns on at least that many. With 19999 it carries instead the free count the rate class itself states, since the tier alone is not enough and the second entitlement names other tiers. A membership at Wanderlane Gold with exactly 6000 qualifying points carries 2 free drivers, and with 5999 carries the free count the rate class itself states.

**A membership at a tier the schedule does not name.** A membership standing at Wanderlane Blue is named in neither entitlement, so whatever points it has accrued, the agreement carries the free count the rate class itself states.
